newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 4.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- President Kim Young-sam on Tuesday endorsed the Presidential Commission on Financial Reform's proposal to establish a financial watchdog body under the direction of the prime minister.

- The Defense Ministry has decided to try and reach an out of court settlement with the Lockheed Martin Corp concerning a dispute in which the ministry claims the U.S. defence contractor overcharged the Korean government in its sale of P-3C anti-submarine patrol aircrafts to Korea back in 1990.
- An autospy showed that a riot policeman who died on Monday during a clash with militant students in Seoul was probably killed when he was run over by a police teargas launcher.
- Police detained 635 students and arrested 49 of them for staging illegal demonstrations.
